description: Fan out a read-only single-router tool (list_*, get_* and others annotated read-only) to many routers in parallel (up to `concurrency`), targeted by routerIds or tag. Unlike bulk_execute, the server refuses every write tool and the traffic-generating diagnostics (ping, traceroute, torch, bandwidth_test) with BULK_READ_TOOL_NOT_READ_ONLY, and never needs a confirmation token, snapshot or journal — so an MCP client can allow bulk_read without allowing fleet-wide writes. Use bulk_execute for anything else. Returns per-router results with succeeded/failed counts.

params.description: Params to pass to the tool (omit routerId — injected per router)

routerIds.description: Explicit list of router IDs to target

tags.description: Target all routers with ALL of these tags (mutually exclusive with routerIds)

toolName.description: Name of the read-only single-router tool to fan out (e.g. list_interfaces)

name: bulk_read
title: Bulk Read
